en: Usage: go run ./scripts/migrate-security-v4 --home DIR [--dry-run] [--locale zh-CN|en]. DIR must be an existing state directory with security-v3.db and daemon.lock. Check the computer clock, stop the daemon and check old operations first.
notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。

zh-CN: 第 3 代接受记录不会迁移。旧 ID 的结果查询将返回未知，绝不重新执行；请核对会话后再决定新操作。请先校准电脑时间；迁移保留旧请求期限和已有时间水位，不把迁移时刻写成新水位。
en: Generation 3 acceptance records are not migrated. Old ID queries return unknown and are never reexecuted; check the session before deciding on a new operation. Check the computer clock first; migration preserves old request deadlines and existing time floors without adding the migration time as a new floor.
notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。

en: Dry run validated; the source is unchanged. Pairing identity, security chain, keys and lease will be preserved; session and account files stay unchanged.
notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。

zh-CN: 升级完成并校验通过，无需重新配对。原库备份为 security-v3.db.backup。仅在 v4 尚未接受新操作时可直接回退：先停止 daemon，移走 security-v4.db 及其 -wal/-shm 文件，再运行旧版。已有 v4 操作时请先按开发说明核对并等待授权期限结束。
en: Upgrade validated; no pairing is needed. The source backup is security-v3.db.backup. Direct rollback is safe only before v4 accepts new operations: stop the daemon, move security-v4.db and its -wal/-shm files aside, then run the old version. Otherwise follow the development guide to check operations and let their authorizations expire first.
notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。

en: Upgrade did not complete; the source was not replaced. Check that --home is an existing state directory with daemon.lock, the daemon is stopped, target and backup are absent, disk is writable, the source is valid generation 3, the clock is correct, old deadlines have passed and existing time floors are not far ahead. Publication failure removes files created by this attempt where possible; if cleanup also fails, keep the daemon stopped and resolve leftover files before retrying.
notes: 电脑端手动 v3→v4 升级工具及 daemon 的本地安全库升级提示；不含账户、路径或密钥变量。

zh-CN: 第 3 代请求记录校验失败，无法信任原请求期限。升级已拒绝，原库、备份和代数标记未改动；请保持 daemon 停止，核对原库或有效备份，不要修改期限或跳过损坏记录。
